producer_report.summary: The change producer prompt now carries one sentence for jobs whose files are under studies/. For every new or reworded statement, the producer opens each cited claim id and checks the claim text says what the sentence says, including who acts. It lists each changed statement with its supporting claim text in the change description. A statement with no supporting claim gets a sourced claim in claims.json or is dropped. The changelog must not say claims support a wording unless they do. The prompt points to the new docs/conventions/study-claim-support.md, which gives the rule and the reason and is marked prose-only. I added a CHANGELOG entry and extended the OLY-B-A7-03 mechanism text in docs/spec.toml. I also updated the producer budget figure in docs/system-facts.md from 1018 to 1043 of 1200, because the budgets test compares it with the computed value. I did not run clippy or the full test suite.

checks_run.note: initially failed on the facts file; passes after updating it

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/producer.md contains a sentence, conditioned on the job's files being under studies/, that requires the producer to open each cited claim id, check the claim text states what the sentence says including who does the action, and list each changed statement with its supporting claim text in the change description (checked by Grep/Read of the file).
criteria_check.evidence: Added the sentence beginning 'When your files are under studies/ and you add or reword a statement, open each claim id it cites...' to the prompt.

criteria_check.criterion: The same prompt says that a statement with no supporting claim must get a sourced claim added to claims.json or be dropped, and that the changelog must not say claims support a wording unless they do.
criteria_check.evidence: The same added text says a statement no claim supports gets a sourced claim in claims.json or is dropped, and that the changelog never says claims support a wording unless they do.

criteria_check.criterion: The prompt text fits the producer (change) token budget (889 of 1200 used); the repository's prompt budget tests pass with the added text.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets passes, including every_role_set_is_within_its_budget. The producer set is now 1043 of 1200. I updated docs/system-facts.md from 1018 to 1043 to match.

criteria_check.criterion: The convention is written for a stranger in docs/conventions/study-claim-support.md (rule, why, enforcing mechanism or marked prose-only), and the prompt points to it.
criteria_check.evidence: Created the file with rule, why and a prose-only enforcing-mechanism section. The prompt cites the path.

criteria_check.criterion: No files under studies/ and no Rust source other than test expectations tied to prompt text are changed; CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the convention.
criteria_check.evidence: The changed files are the prompt, the new doc, CHANGELOG.md, docs/spec.toml and docs/system-facts.md. There is no Rust source change and nothing under studies/. CHANGELOG.md has a new entry under Unreleased > Changed.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy and cargo test all pass, including prompt structure/mirror checks over the edited prompt and docs.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks for clippy and the full test suite. I ran fmt --check, the budgets, mirrors and policy tests, and the athena-cap-change tests, and all pass.

mistakes: The brief said the producer set was at 889 of 1200 words, but the facts file showed 1018 and the computed value after my edit is 1043. I did not check the brief's figure against the facts file before editing.
learnings: The producer prompt budget figure is mirrored in docs/system-facts.md and checked by the budgets test. Any prompt edit needs that figure updated.
